## Description

Ranks assets using a forecast score, holds the top K, and permits a controlled number of replacements each rebalance to reduce turnover.

## Where it may fit

Cross-sectional ranking applications where frequent complete rank reshuffling would create excessive trading.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, multi-asset ranking portfolios and ML-driven ETFs.

## Required data

Forecast/ranking scores, point-in-time universe, prices, liquidity filters, turnover constraints and rebalance schedule.

## Caveats

Performance depends on alpha model, K, turnover and cost assumptions; rank changes are not necessarily economically significant.
